caveats: Opening hours are NOT published anywhere — the site shows 'Call for today's hours' and click-to-call only; no hours were invented.

No verified dish names or prices — the menu board uses generic serving types drawn from the verified cuisine (house bowl / large bowl / family tray / falafel / lentil soup / Egyptian tea); 'Prices on request' appears once, in the menu section.
No verified founding year — none is stated anywhere on the site.

Address conflict: Wikivoyage street address (Muslim Bin Mujafal Subaih Street, Shubra, Taif 26513) is used on the site; TripAdvisor's variant (7565 Abu Bakr As Siddiq, Shubra, Taif 21944) is recorded here only.
Delivery is not listed anywhere — the site says to ask about delivery when calling; no delivery claim is made.
No verified standalone logo was found — the site uses a clean text wordmark with the Arabic name; no logo was invented.

Photographs are free-licensed illustrative food photography (Wikimedia Commons / Flickr CC BY / CC BY-SA, and Unsplash), not the restaurant's own dishes — the gallery carries a note saying so. Two photos show real koshary (Wikimedia Commons: Cairo_koshary.jpg, Egyptian_Koshari.jpg). One tea photo shows Lipton-branded glasses (a real documentary photo of Egyptian tea service); one gallery photo shows a koshary counter with staff (documentary shot, faces visible). The Abu Tariq koshari photo was rejected because its cups carry a competing restaurant's branding; the Zooba koshari photo was rejected because its tray carries another chain's branding.
Google Maps embed could not be visually verified rendering in this VM's browser; the 'Open in Google Maps' link is present as fallback.
The Facebook page could not be fully rendered (login wall) — the Arabic business name was verified from the page's og:description metadata instead.
